prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
No kind of change has been shown to be helpful yet, as all 8 tests resulted in no clear effect.
Finish new screen changes showed no clear effect across 3 tests.
Evidence is still thin for adoption new screen, adoption redesign, finish new flow, home redesign, and sign-in hint changes, as each has only 1 test so far.
Positive predictions were generally too high, particularly for adoption redesign (predicted +12.0%, measured -3.4%) and new flows.
Negative predictions were too low, as both tests with negative predictions (adoption new screen and home redesign) measured positive results.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: +0.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: -1.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_flow: -2.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: +0.3% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- home, redesign: +1.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, hint: +0.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Pet Interaction Basics Screen: Insert a new screen before completion showing desktop controls for summoning, hiding, and talking to the pet. (why: 3 support emails indicated post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide the desktop pet.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Pet Selection Two Column Comparison Layout: Redesign the pet selection screen to a two-column layout comparing traits side-by-side to speed up decision-making. (why: Adoption has the lowest step conversion rate (60.9%) and long decision time (median 89s, mean 1017s).)
2: [home, new_flow] Background Rendering Notification Flow: Add an optional ready notification toggle on the waiting screen so users get alerted when pet rendering completes. (why: The waiting stage takes a median of 201s (mean 2336s) and users report stalled launches.)
3: [choose_path, new_screen] Onboarding Path Overview Screen: Add a path overview screen before selection to set clear expectations for the onboarding steps. (why: Overall onboarding completion is low at 17.8%, and choose_path has a high mean duration of 514s.)
4: [adoption, hint] Photo Quality Requirement Hint: Add a photo requirement hint on the photo upload screen recommending clear lighting and unobstructed faces. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failing or producing distorted results.)
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Display Launch Tip: Display a desktop launch tip on the waiting screen explaining how to locate the pet icon in the taskbar if it doesn't open immediately. (why: 3 support emails noted that the pet does not show up on the desktop or the app fails to open.)
6: [choose_path, copy] Story Goal Clarification Copy: Rephrase story copy to reassure users that companion options and behaviors can be changed later. (why: High mean time on choose_path (514s) indicates hesitation during early choices.)
7: [sign_in, incentive] Cloud Save Protection Badge: Add a cloud save security badge component above sign-in options to emphasize data retention. (why: 8 support emails cited accounts resetting or pets disappearing after re-authenticating.)
8: [finish, notification] System Tray Location Notification: Add a notification hint on home intro highlighting the system tray icon location for quick access. (why: 4 support emails mentioned desktop feature misbehavior or confusion accessing controls post-setup.)

scores.note: Finish loses 35.2% and 3 emails report control confusion, but new screens on finish tested 3 times with negligible lift (+0.3%).
Adoption has highest drop (39.1%) and long duration, but previous adoption redesign measured -1.3% lift.
Home step has long wait times and stalled launch reports, but new flows generally haven't performed well.
Choose_path loses 23.8% with high mean duration, but adding a new screen introduces friction without proven historical benefit.
Targeting adoption step (lowest conversion) with clear support email evidence via a low-cost hint.
Strong alignment between support emails and wait duration; simple info tip is cheap to implement.
Addresses high choose_path duration with low-cost copy change, though evidence from emails is absent.
High email volume (8 emails) regarding account reset concerns targeting sign_in step.
Finish step drops 35.2% and 4 emails cite post-setup confusion; low-cost notification hint.
